theorems.name: Submission.codim1_lur_no_oriented_normal_frame
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (ν : Euclid (n + 1)), 1 ≤ n → ‖ν‖ = 1 → ∃ σ : Fin n → Euclid (n + 1), Orthonormal ℝ σ ∧ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range σ) = (Submodule.span ℝ {ν})ᗮ ∧ Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun r c : Fin (n + 1) => (Fin.cons ν σ : Fin (n + 1) → Euclid (n + 1)) c r) = -1
